Verification currency — an executed unit's AGGREGATED verify.json must adjudicate the iteration its debrief claims. Four exhaustive, mutually exclusive arms over {SUPERSEDED, AHEAD, CURRENT} x {IN_FLIGHT, not IN_FLIGHT} behind two guards (an indeterminate debrief, and an absent/unusable verify, are DECLINED to I9's domain — no double-charging): I43-a verify.iteration < debrief.iteration off-window is a hard FAIL (SUPERSEDED, the measured defect class); I43-b verify.iteration > debrief.iteration off-window is a hard FAIL (AHEAD — no legal LT7 transient puts the verify ahead, since LT7 increments `iteration` BEFORE the next EXECUTE writes its debrief, so it is either a rollback under a live verification or an AUTHORED iteration); I43-d a mismatch INSIDE the in-flight window is an exit-neutral NOTE; I43-ok equality emits a positive assertion so a silently-skipped predicate is distinguishable from a clean one (closes the silent-skip domain). IN_FLIGHT(u) := I9's window (phase == P6_EXECUTE_VERIFY and fsm status in executing/verifying) PLUS a third conjunct `gates.signoff_confirmed is not True`. BOTH existing window sites are CITED and BYTE-UNTOUCHED, never hoisted (pure insertion is a confirmed guardrail for this change) — and they are cited BY CONTENT, never by offset, because every offset in that file drifts: `grep -n '^ *if phase == "P6_EXECUTE_VERIFY"' validate_run.py` returns exactly 2 hits, the FIRST being I42-3's digest-drift window and the SECOND I9's missing-verification window. An earlier revision of this title published `validate_run.py:5594` and `(I9 :5594, I42-3 :5555)`; NEITHER offset resolved to the site it named, which is why the numbers are deleted rather than refreshed. The third conjunct is LOAD-BEARING: without the first two the predicate acts as a de-facto live guard on the sole back-edge -- THE PROOF STEP PREVIOUSLY PUBLISHED HERE IS WITHDRAWN (predicate-spec.md §1.3-a, §9-R18). It read `hard-FAILs every legal RETRY, where debrief==N and verify==N-1 BY CONSTRUCTION`, which substitutes the FSM COUNTER for the ARTIFACT FIELD this predicate actually reads: LT7 increments the counter on the edge OUT of RETRY and the executor writes the next debrief afterwards, inside EXECUTE, so AT RETRY the on-disk pair is (N-1, N-1) and CURRENT is TRUE. The conclusion survives on the ARTIFACT TIMELINE: the non-CURRENT transient opens when EXECUTE writes debrief N and closes when the aggregated verify N is written, spanning the EXECUTE->VERIFY leg and the interior of VERIFY -- exactly the interval the two copied conjuncts cover -- and the hazard is PARALLEL WAVES, since a validation triggered by one unit's pair closing also inspects same-wave siblings sitting at (N, N-1). Stated as a PROPERTY, not a census, because the census moves between readings; without it the three motivating units (all `verifying` at P6) downgrade to NOTEs that the SKILL.md-mandated --quiet then eats, leaving the predicate INERT on the very run that motivates it. Reads the AGGREGATED verify only — per-member panel verify files are a per-iteration audit trail by design and are normatively out of domain. Never reads `retries` (I4's ceiling iteration <= retries+1 is neither widened nor narrowed: this is an equality between two ARTIFACTS) and never reads `verdict` (complete means CURRENT, not PASS — a current FAIL at retries==2 exits via ESCALATE).
